treatment_summary: The plan addresses metabolic syndrome by initiating atorvastatin for severe hyperlipidaemia, starting metformin and semaglutide to improve insulin sensitivity and promote weight loss, and optimizing antihypertensive therapy through dose reduction of lisinopril and discontinuation of hydrochlorothiazide due to low BP. Non‑pharmacological measures (diet, exercise, diabetes prevention programme) are implied. Chronic pain is managed with an opioid taper, addition of duloxetine and regular paracetamol, following NICE NG193. All recommendations align with NICE CG181/PH46, NG28, NG136, and NG193, with monitoring and safety checks outlined.
